assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: 4:3 editorial activity illustration for a Bulgarian marketplace provider card, clearly not a real provider photograph. A small children's choir rehearsal, candid over-shoulder view from behind a row of four distinct primary school-age children seated in a semicircle, warmly dressed in normal casual clothes, a conductor cues them in the middle distance; two understated music stands and no instruments. Focus on natural child posture and the rehearsal activity; the room is anonymous and softly blurred, with natural window light, cream walls, walnut and muted sage. Full-width documentary horizontal still, keep the main group well inside the central frame for mobile cropping. No signs, school uniforms, text, logos, sheet-music writing readable, branding or watermarks.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: centered square-friendly detail image for one synthesizer lesson in a booking marketplace. Tight three-quarter overhead crop of a single learner's hands correctly playing the black and white keys of a compact real electronic music synthesizer; single unbranded instrument with pitch and modulation wheels, analog control knobs on the black panel, realistic plugged-in cable and the stand just visible. A tutor's hand outside the keybed demonstrates one knob; modest oatmeal sleeve and soft daylight. Exactly one instrument. No acoustic piano, no choir, no performance stage, no visible faces or identifiable room; distinct graphic diagonal composition that reads at 150 pixels. Natural tones and credible keyboard anatomy, no legible text, brands, watermarks, added UI or AI badges.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: a square service-menu illustration specifically for a children's group singing lesson, not a documentary image of any actual venue. Very tight profile photograph at eye-level of three school-age children singing in an informal rehearsal, looking to the right at an off-frame teacher. Frame only their faces and shoulders in an angled line, one child closest in dusty-blue top and one in burgundy, breathing naturally with relaxed expressions. Cool-neutral window light from the right, soft plain blue-grey backdrop, no classroom furniture or music stands or conductor in frame. A candid editorial detail, distinctly different from a wide rehearsal-room cover seen from behind. Realistic proportions, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
